meta.description: Brand-safe sarcastic idioms, one-liners, and humor patterns for short-form content generation.

purpose: Curate brand-safe sarcastic idioms and one-liners with paraphrase guidance and product placement notes for short-form.

principles: Benign Violation: Violate expectations but signal safety via tone/context/tags.
Incongruity + Paraprosdokian: Setup -> flip -> benign tag.
Deadpan delivery: Straight face amplifies sarcasm without escalating harm.

common_sarcastic_idioms: Oh, because that makes total sense.
Tell me something I don’t know.
I’ll make a note of that.
sarcastic_one_liners: Silence is golden. Duct tape is silver.
If you find it hard to laugh at yourself, I can help.
Light travels faster than sound; some people seem bright until they speak.
I’m not saying I hate Mondays; Mondays hate me first.
Cancel my subscription—I don’t need your issues.
I clapped because it’s over, not because I liked it.
Keep rolling your eyes—maybe you’ll find a brain back there.
Sometimes I wish I was nicer, then I laugh and carry on.

deadpan_patterns.example: Incredible initiative… for something no one asked for.
Breaking news: problem still a problem.
Powered by spite and two brain cells on strike.
I’d love to, but my calendar says ‘no’.

snarky_comebacks: It’s okay if you disagree; I can’t force you to be right.
Please cancel my subscription to your issues.
I’d explain it, but I’ve run out of crayons.

paraphrasing: Prefer idioms and public-domain-ish common sayings.
Swap nouns/verbs to produce fresh surface forms.

boost_placement.placement_pattern: One-liner -> quick Boost mention as calm solution -> benign tag.

localization_pitfalls: Avoid region-specific references that don’t translate.

platform_policies.language: No explicit profanity, slurs, body-shaming, harassment.
platform_policies.adult_content: No explicit sexual language; mild innuendo only.
platform_policies.alcohol: Casual references OK in organic; avoid in ads.

mix_and_match: Deadpan opener + nuisance + Boost tag + button
Lab report: Preliminary results: {nuisance}. Intervention: Boost ({benefit}). {button}
Self-diagnosis: Symptoms: {nuisance}. Treatment plan: Boost for {benefit}. {button}
Calendar snark: Invited: {nuisance}. RSVP: Boost for {benefit}. {button}
Performance review: Q4 update: {nuisance}. Countermeasure: Boost ({benefit}). {button}
Travel advisory: Advisory: {nuisance}. Alternate route: Boost -> {benefit}. {button}

paraprosdokian_stems: I didn’t say it was your fault; I said I was blaming you.
The last thing I want to do is hurt you—but it’s still on my list.
Change is inevitable, except from a vending machine.
I used to be indecisive; now I’m not so sure.
I want to die peacefully in my sleep, not screaming like my passengers.
I’m great at multi-tasking: I can waste time, be unproductive, and procrastinate all at once.
I asked for directions; now I’m even more lost.
I’m not lazy; I’m on energy-saving mode.
I have standards; they’re just set to airplane mode.
If I agreed with you, we’d both be wrong.
I didn’t trip; the floor attacked me.
My train of thought left the station without me.
I’m not arguing; I’m just explaining why I’m right.
I can explain it to you, but I can’t understand it for you.
I have the memory of a goldfish—some days that’s the dream.

cues.prosody: Drawl positive word, quick micro-pause, deadpan cadence on button.
cues.punctuation: Ellipses (...) for beat, em dash (-) for twist, ironic quotes, parenthetical asides.
cues.timing: 1-2 beats setup, 1 beat flip, immediate tag. Total 6-15s.
cues.visuals: Bold/colored keywords on twist, tiny delay animation on tag.

meta_practices: Keep it brief; don’t drown the product message.
Breaking the 4th wall examples: 'Yes, this is an ad.', 'Narrator: they actually did buy the patch.'
